name: Lava Hop Adventure
competency: One-to-one correspondence, progressive ordinal counting, and spatial path traversal on authentic street crossing layouts
ncertStandard: Grade 1 & 2 Mathematics: Joyful Mathematics Chapter 2 (Counting & Hopscotch Paths)
overview: Inspired by the classic childhood game 'the road is lava', children cross a realistic asphalt volcano street by hopping only on blank white stepping stones. When hopped on, each stone reveals its sequential number and counts aloud (1, 2, 3...) until reaching the safe sidewalk.
learningOutcomes: Develop 1-to-1 correspondence through tactile hopping interactions
Discover sequential numbers dynamically upon hopping rather than pre-printed clues
Reinforce number pronunciation and verbal counting with browser speech synthesis
Learn spatial risk-assessment by distinguishing safe white stepping stones from boiling red lava

levels.name: The Suburban Street Crossing
levels.description: 5 white stones hidden among bubbling lava cracks
